subject: Retention credit approvals — Platform org reorg cohort
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Retention credit request: Platform infra reorg cohort

Hi Lauren,

Following the Platform infra reorg (completed last week) I ran a quick risk scan and have two senior ICs who are at elevated flight risk:

- Emma Santiago (Acme integration lead) — critical for the next 3 months of customer migrations; recently received two external approaches.
- Rahul Mehra — deep infra/ops expertise; single-threaded on a key performance uplift.

I'm proposing a one-time retention credit for each: Emma $25,000 and Rahul $15,000 (gross one-time payout). This is outside the standard merit cycle and exceeds manager discretionary caps. Rationale: both are high-impact, hard-to-replace, and their work directly protects recurring revenue tied to our platform integrations.

Requested path: can we route as a leadership exception (one-off retention credit) with an expedited approval so Payroll can process for Jan 2027 payroll? I can share context notes and sync with Finance.

Attachments: I have a working spreadsheet with justification and suggested wording for the credits — I'll send it if helpful.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credit request: Platform infra reorg cohort

Monica / Markus — looping you in to request an exception approval for two off-cycle retention credits Vivek called out. I've attached a draft spreadsheet with names, proposed amounts, manager notes, and suggested payout language.

Summary:
- Emma Santiago — $25,000 one-time retention credit, justified by near-term customer migration ownership and active external interest.
- Rahul Mehra — $15,000 one-time retention credit, single-threaded subject matter expert for infra perf uplift.

Ask: Please confirm approval path (leadership exception) and whether Finance needs any additional fields in the approval matrix to process by Jan payroll. If approved, Neha — can you advise on GL code and whether we need a vendor/one-off payment flow vs payroll gross-up?

Attachments: [Attachment: retention_cohort_2026-12.xlsx] (spreadsheet includes manager comments and proposed wording for offer).

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to review the justification together — Vivek can join.

Thanks,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credit request: Platform infra reorg cohort

Thanks for flagging — reviewed the spreadsheet. A few clarifying items before I can route for final sign-off:

1) Manager calibration: please add 1–2 bullets per person summarizing recent performance calibration (e.g., last performance rating, any recent stretch assignments). We need this to justify exception above discretionary limits.
2) Timing and payroll treatment: We prefer to route as a taxable payroll payment in Jan (vs vendor payment) to avoid miscoding for benefits/stock reporting, but we need Finance to confirm GL.
3) Equity/comp interplay: confirm both employees are not already queued for any near-term equity refreshes that would create double-counting risk.

I've attached an approval matrix template (attached) — please populate manager calibration bullets and return; I'll then route to Markus for executive approval.

Attachments: [Attachment: approval_matrix.pdf]

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner, People Ops

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-04T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credit request: Platform org reorg cohort

Thanks team — reviewed the matrix Monica sent and the manager notes Vivek included. I approve the one-time retention credits as requested (Emma $25k, Rahul $15k) with the following conditions:

- Manager calibration bullets added to the matrix and retained in HR case file (Monica will confirm).
- Finance (Neha) signs off on payroll routing and GL code; payment must be processed via payroll in the Jan 2027 run.
- We record the exception in the comp council log and note rationale to preserve audit trail.

Assuming those boxes are checked, Lauren — please proceed with final communication to the managers and instruct Finance. If any of the above cannot be met, escalate back to me.

Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of People & Talent Strategy

Summary of final items attached:
- Finalized matrix with manager bullets and backup rationale.
- Requested payroll date: Jan 15, 2027 (regular payroll run).
- Payout amounts: Emma Santiago $25,000; Rahul Mehra $15,000 (gross, taxable).

If Finance confirms by EOD 2026-12-08 I will notify the managers and schedule the short employee communications (script included in the spreadsheet).
